author: jochembrouwer
content:
Hi <@372317178906542081>, <@1361003005691822160>, <@425274498732916736>, the purpose of this channel is to discuss Ephemeral Accounts such as discussed in https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/arguments-for-ephemeral-accounts-and-implementation-approaches. In particular working on creating a non-deprecated way to use the pattern (`CREATE[2] + SELFDESTRUCT`), such as https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8360 by adding this as opcode. For this ideally the specs and tests of this EIP have to be written by the community to help get the EIP move forward (and ship it in Hegotá 🙂 )

Does someone have the Discord handle of Helkomine/abc-123-c (authors of EIP-8360)? We should also tag them here.

For now I would invite anyone who wants to use the non-deprecated way of ephemeral accounts to read the EIP and to leave feedback. For these, use https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8360-tcreate-opcode/29258, lets use this channel for (quick) async text comms. I will also sit down and read the EIP, but now from a more technical viewpoint 🙂

Let me know if there are any questions 😄
